reviews.comment:
Malísima. Andaba un tipo a los gritos a lo q pregunté a quien nos despachaba y solo bajaba la mirada otro automovilista nos dijo q era un tal Pérez q es gerente o algo así. Q les exige a los playeros retener al q carga combustible con el fin de q ingresen a comprar. Ingrese pq teniendo niños siempre algo quieren no habia hamburguesas no tenía sandwich de jamón crudo ya q este sr se portó bien con nosotros le preg algún lado dónde comprar me dijo q 25 km pasando catriel una excelente YPF. Cuestión q el tipo este seguía gritando se subió a un auto y se fue. Mi marido renegando pq no había wifi para pagar con la app y señal de tel menos. Desp de 45 min trajeron un posnet de no se dónde nos cobraron así. Factura ni pedir, el baño un asco sin papel higiénico. La verdad pésimo el servicio. Asiq bueno llegada mis vacaciones haré mi email a ACA central pq la verdad q es un desastre. El maltrato q sufren esos pibes...
Cómo quiere q me comunique en una semana vuelvo a pasar si quiere me acerco y lo conversamos.. y borre la publicación q ya tengo capturas de pantalla de como contesta groseramente

(Translated by Google)
Terrible. There was a guy yelling, so I asked who was serving us, and he just looked down. Another driver told us it was a guy named Pérez, a manager or something. He says he demands that the attendants keep the person filling up so they'll come in and buy something. I went in because, with kids, they always want something. They didn't have hamburgers or prosciutto sandwiches. Since this gentleman was nice to us, I asked him where to buy something, and he told me there was an excellent YPF 25 km past Catriel. Anyway, this guy kept yelling, got in a car, and left. My husband was complaining because there was no Wi-Fi to pay with the app, and even less phone signal. After 45 minutes, they brought a card reader from who-knows-where and charged us that way. Don't even ask for a receipt, and the bathroom was disgusting, with no toilet paper. The service was truly awful. So, when my vacation comes, I'm going to email ACA headquarters because it's a complete disaster. The mistreatment those kids suffer... How do you want me to contact you? I'll come back in a week if you want, I can approach you and we can talk... and delete the post, I already have screenshots of how rudely you respond.
